statement: Metadata overcommit in btrfs is only allowed against unallocated device space, so read the unallocated figure in btrfs filesystem usage before assuming a metadata reservation can still succeed.
quote: btrfs_can_overcommit(), but it only applies to unallocated space.

statement: The kernel wants about ten data block groups of unallocated space as a buffer, so unallocated shrinking toward that target signals reclaim pressure before any metadata reservation actually fails.
quote: A reasonable buffer for unallocated space is 10 data block_groups.
